indicators.name: refund_rate
indicators.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_refunded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)

indicators.name: gross_margin
indicators.description: Gross profit divided by sales amount.

indicators.name: repeat_purchase_rate
indicators.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_repeat_purchase = 1 THEN customer_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)
